entities.summary: Sainte-Anne de la Butte-aux-Cailles is a Roman Catholic church located in the [Butte aux Cailles quarter of the 13th arrondissement of Paris, at 188 Rue Tolbiac. It was built between 1894 and 1912. It is noted for its Art Deco stained glass windows, added in 1938.
